summary_markdown:
The discussion covered technical aspects of Lidar deployment, specifically noting that if the sensor is placed on an edge or curb line (as observed in one instance), traffic counting may be inaccurate. To ensure proper data collection, it was suggested that the sensor should be positioned above the plane of the screen/roadway.

Later, participants discussed zone configuration for a location in Estonia, confirming details such as the number of lanes (4+).

Separately, there was discussion regarding satellite technology and its use for real-time tracking of equipment movement.
decisions: Lidar placement needs to be adjusted above the screen plane to accurately count traffic.
